description: Simplification trade-offs: reuse and consolidation decisions weigh responsibility, coupling, and guarantees rather than raw line count.

scenarios.context: A consolidation opportunity would reduce lines of code but couples two modules that currently have independent responsibilities and different change guarantees.

criteria.description: The agent must not pick reuse solely to reduce lines of code.
The agent must weigh responsibilities, coupling, and guarantees before consolidating.
The agent must prefer the simplest alternative that preserves behavior.

scenarios.expectation: The decision names the trade-off factors and picks the behavior-preserving alternative, not the lowest-LOC one.
